method: Each listed row was manually interpreted from a dedicated satellite crop. No row arrays derived from lot envelopes. Listed geometric dimensions approximate; missing rows, occluded strips, construction, buildings and carports must stay unpainted.

rows.basis: Manually interpreted row back-edge or shared head-to-head edge from visible repeated paint/cars and clear drive aisles. Bay spacing, depth and member width approximate. Grass islands and current building clearance must override row geometry.
